statement: The most-active CBOT corn futures contract will settle at or above 6.00 USD per bushel on 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if CME Group settlement data shows the most-active corn contract settling at or above 6.00 USD per bushel on 2026-11-30; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: The most-active CBOT corn contract settles below 6.00 USD per bushel on 2026-11-30.
